a retrospective cohort study can be used for studying the etiology of malignant neoplastic diseases, but it is essential to pay more attention to quality control procedures in such studies.
the questionnaire survey was not an optimal method for studying the risk factors of breast cancer.
the questionnaire is a useful and reliable instrument in the study of the epidemiology of breast cancer.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a high-quality study is a prerequisite for the success of any study.
the quality of data collected in retrospective studies is highly dependent on the quality of the information provided by the respondents.
the questionnaire should not be considered the sole tool for data collection, but rather as one of many.
